description:
Title: Ordering in an Online Shop  

A customer that logs into an E-Shop system and has to wait for its login confirmation (its credentials are checked by the system).
If the login was successful then the customer can continue to select products, else the shopping experience stops.
After selecting a product the customer has to add it to a shopping cart, save the product and check if every product was already selected.
These steps repeat until all products were selected.
Then the order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared.
For the payment the customer has to enter its payment data and has to wait until the bank confirms the payment.
While waiting for the payment confirmation the customer can enter its shipping address (an independent billing address can be entered if the shipping address is not equal to the billing address).
Finally if the address and the payment steps are executed then the order will be finished by the system.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OnlineShopOrder" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/online-shop-order">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_LoginCredentials" name="Login credentials"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_LoginSuccessful" name="Login successful"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_LoginFailed" name="Login failed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentData" name="Payment data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentConfirmed" name="Payment confirmed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CheckoutCompleted" name="Checkout completed"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_OnlineShopOrder" name="Ordering in an Online Shop">
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_EShop" name="E-Shop System" processRef="Process_EShop"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Bank" name="Bank"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_LoginCredentials" name="Login credentials" messageRef="Msg_LoginCredentials" sourceRef="Task_SendCredentials" targetRef="Start_LoginReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_LoginSuccessful" name="Login successful" messageRef="Msg_LoginSuccessful" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginSuccess" targetRef="Event_LoginSuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_LoginFailed" name="Login failed" messageRef="Msg_LoginFailed" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginFailed" targetRef="Event_LoginFailed"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed" messageRef="Msg_OrderPlaced" sourceRef="Task_SendOrder" targetRef="Event_OrderPlaced"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request" messageRef="Msg_PaymentRequest" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Event_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentData" name="Payment data" messageRef="Msg_PaymentData" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentData" targetRef="Part_Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentConfirmed" name="Payment confirmed" messageRef="Msg_PaymentConfirmed" sourceRef="Part_Bank" targetRef="Event_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CheckoutCompleted" name="Checkout completed" messageRef="Msg_CheckoutCompleted" sourceRef="Task_SendCheckout" targetRef="Event_CheckoutCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Customer starts shopping"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterLogin" name="Enter login credentials"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendCredentials" name="Send login credentials" messageRef="Msg_LoginCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_LoginResult" name="Wait for login confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_LoginSuccessful" name="Login successful">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_LoginSuccessful" messageRef="Msg_LoginSuccessful"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_LoginFailed" name="Login failed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_LoginFailed" messageRef="Msg_LoginFailed"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ShoppingStopped" name="Shopping experience stopped"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ProductMerge" name="Product selection loop"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectProduct" name="Select product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllSelected" name="All products selected?" default="Flow_NotAllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOrder" name="Send order" messageRef="Msg_OrderPlaced"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentRequest" messageRef="Msg_PaymentRequest"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CustSplit" name="Payment and shipping"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterPayment" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentData" name="Send payment data" messageRef="Msg_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PaymentConfirmed" name="Payment confirmed by bank">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentConfirmed" messageRef="Msg_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterShipping" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingSplit" name="Billing address differs from shipping address?" default="Flow_BillingSame"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBilling" name="Enter billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingMerge" name="Billing address handled"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CustJoin" name="Payment and address completed"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendCheckout" name="Send checkout completed" messageRef="Msg_CheckoutCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed by customer"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_EnterLogin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C2" sourceRef="Task_EnterLogin" targetRef="Task_SendCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C3" sourceRef="Task_SendCredentials" targetRef="Gateway_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C4" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginResult" targetRef="Event_LoginSuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C5" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginResult" targetRef="Event_LoginFailed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C6" sourceRef="Event_LoginSuccessful" targetRef="Gateway_ProductMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C7" sourceRef="Event_LoginFailed" targetRef="End_ShoppingStopped"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C8" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductMerge" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C9" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C10" sourceRef="Task_AddToCart" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C11" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="Gateway_AllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotAllSelected" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AllSelected" targetRef="Gateway_ProductMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C13" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AllSelected" targetRef="Task_SendOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allProductsSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C14" sourceRef="Task_SendOrder" targetRef="Event_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C15" sourceRef="Event_PaymentRequest" targetRef="Gateway_CustSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C16" sourceRef="Gateway_CustSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C17" sourceRef="Task_EnterPayment" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C18" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentData" targetRef="Event_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C19" sourceRef="Event_PaymentConfirmed" targetRef="Gateway_CustJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C20" sourceRef="Gateway_CustSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C21" sourceRef="Task_EnterShipping" targetRef="Gateway_BillingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C22" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterBilling">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${billingAddressDiffers}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingSame" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingSplit" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C24" sourceRef="Task_EnterBilling" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C25" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingMerge" targetRef="Gateway_CustJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C26" sourceRef="Gateway_CustJoin" targetRef="Task_SendCheckout"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C27" sourceRef="Task_SendCheckout" targetRef="End_OrderCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_EShop" name="E-Shop System" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_LoginReceived" name="Login credentials received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_LoginCredentials" messageRef="Msg_LoginCredentials"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckCredentials" name="Check credentials"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CredentialsCheck" name="Credentials valid?" default="Flow_CredInvalid"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLoginSuccess" name="Send login successful" messageRef="Msg_LoginSuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLoginFailed" name="Send login failed" messageRef="Msg_LoginFailed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LoginRejected" name="Login rejected"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderPlaced" messageRef="Msg_OrderPlaced"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FinishOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SysSplit" name="Payment and shipment preparation"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SysJoin" name="Preparation completed"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentRequest" name="Send payment request" messageRef="Msg_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CheckoutCompleted" name="Checkout completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CheckoutCompleted" messageRef="Msg_CheckoutCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FinalizeOrder" name="Finalize order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderFinished" name="Order finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S1" sourceRef="Start_LoginReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S2" sourceRef="Task_CheckCredentials" targetRef="Gateway_CredentialsCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S3" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CredentialsCheck" targetRef="Task_SendLoginSuccess">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${credentialsValid}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CredInvalid" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CredentialsCheck" targetRef="Task_SendLoginFailed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S5" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginFailed" targetRef="End_LoginRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S6" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginSuccess" targetRef="Event_OrderPlaced"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S7" sourceRef="Event_OrderPlaced" targetRef="Task_FinishOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S8" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrder" targetRef="Gateway_SysSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S9" sourceRef="Gateway_SysSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S10" sourceRef="Gateway_SysSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S11" sourceRef="Task_PreparePayment" targetRef="Gateway_SysJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S12" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Gateway_SysJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S13" sourceRef="Gateway_SysJoin" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S14" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Event_CheckoutCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S15" sourceRef="Event_CheckoutCompleted" targetRef="Task_FinalizeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S16" sourceRef="Task_FinalizeOrder" targetRef="End_OrderFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
